title: Security Office Key
summary: Unlocks both entrances to the Steel Watch Foundry Security Office.

fields.Use: Unlock the rear double doors at X −316, Y −163 or the upper gallery entrance at X −316, Y −134. DC 15 Sleight of Hand also opens them.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
